name: Genius games & flashcards books for kids-learn ABC

ios.desc:
Brainturk Toddler app can be an intriguing window into the world for your preschooler. The cognitive games developed with the help of neuroscientists and researchers focusing on brain training will improve your kid's memory and fine motor skills 

Games Include:
 Go/No Go:  train inhibition ( used in autism studies)
 Corsi blocks: train your short term memory
 Color Match: train your brain to make decisions quick by choosing if the colors are of the same
Odd man out: spot the odd man out in the given list

Books:
 Learn letters ABC .. PBS etc
 Numbers: 123 
 Solar system: Pictures of planet Mercury, Venus, Earth and other planets

Every kid begins his homeschool by learning ABC, 123.
